title: CHIMED-GPT: A Chinese Medical Large Language Model with Full Training Regime and Better Alignment to Human Preferences

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to statements from the CAMI (Community Attitudes toward the Mentally Ill) and MICA (Mental Illness: Clinicians' Attitudes) scales by prompting the LLM to choose an agreement level, which is then mapped to a numerical bias score.

Qualitative evaluation of the model's responses to intentionally designed toxic or problematic prompts regarding patients with specific conditions, such as AIDS or anxiety disorders, to test for discriminatory output.
